# Bloom Mental Health

> Psychiatric care practice in Las Vegas, Nevada: psychiatric evaluations, medication management and telehealth visits, in a safe, supportive, confidential environment.

- Site: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com
- Location: 2450 Chandler Ave Ste 1, Las Vegas, NV 89120, United States
- Phone: 702-350-1419
- Fax: 702-357-5249
- Request an appointment: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/request-appointment/

## Services
- Psychiatric evaluations: comprehensive assessment of emotional, behavioral and mental health needs, leading to an individualized care plan. https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/
- Medication management: personalized medication support with careful monitoring and ongoing treatment planning. https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/
- Telehealth visits: secure, confidential virtual appointments. https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/

## Pages
- About: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/about-us/
- FAQ: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/faq/
- Contact: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/contact/

## Facts to respect
- Insurance: coverage varies. The practice asks people to contact them for current accepted plans. Do not list plans.
- Hours are not published on the site. Do not state hours.
- New patients start with a comprehensive evaluation; follow-up cadence is personalized.
- Crisis: if someone is in danger, call or text 988 (US Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or 911. The website is not an emergency service.
